actual_file_scope: Freshly reread complete revised three-unit file. Ordinary isolated Bezout is now attributed to the exactly read Mondal primary source; the finite-flat/component extraction proof remains internal.
checks: Ordinary isolated affine Bezout deformation: regular-sequence t-flat complete local pieces and the CRT/Nakayama quotient of the generic finite complete intersection.
For the CRT argument the polynomial-family image is an R-submodule of a finite module over the Noetherian DVR R=k[[epsilon]], hence finite; ordinary Nakayama therefore applies to its cokernel.
Finite flat coordinate powering, scheme-length multiplicativity by product of weights, with no separability requirement.
Generic combinations form parameter ideals at every selected component prime simultaneously; generic affine hyperplanes meet the good loci and avoid component intersections.
Open and clopen counts, padded layer-variable factorial estimate, and logarithmic bound O(f m^2 s^2).
Presentation is an explicit hypothesis; no geometric atlas/count claim is inferred from tangent dimensions.

Rescaled weights E j cancel E for the O(f m^2 s^2) bundle-variable block; the O(f m s) weight-one background costs only O(f m s log(ms)) and is absorbed in O(f r^2). All constants and padding conditions checked.
